#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Archive the contents of SRC_DIR into DEST_DIR and keep only the newest KEEP archives.
# Usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]
set -euo pipefail

# Byte-wise glob ordering keeps "newest = greatest name" independent of the locale.
export LC_ALL=C

usage() {
  echo "usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
  exit 2
}

if [[ $# -lt 2 || $# -gt 3 ]]; then
  usage
fi

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

if [[ ! $keep =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( 10#$keep < 1 )); then
  usage
fi
keep=$((10#$keep))

if [[ ! -d $src ]]; then
  echo "backup.sh: not a directory: $src" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p -- "$dest"

stamp=${BACKUP_NOW:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"

# -C makes the archive entries relative to SRC_DIR.
tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

# Glob results are sorted ascending, so the newest archives are at the end.
shopt -s nullglob
candidates=("$dest"/backup-*.tar.gz)
shopt -u nullglob

backups=()
for file in "${candidates[@]}"; do
  if [[ -f $file ]]; then
    backups+=("$file")
  fi
done

count=${#backups[@]}
for ((i = 0; i < count - keep; i++)); do
  rm -f -- "${backups[i]}"
done

echo "$archive"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Archive the contents of SRC_DIR into DEST_DIR and keep only the newest KEEP archives.
# Usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]
set -euo pipefail

# Byte-wise glob ordering keeps "newest = greatest name" independent of the locale.
export LC_ALL=C

usage() {
  echo "usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
  exit 2
}

if [[ $# -lt 2 || $# -gt 3 ]]; then
  usage
fi

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

if [[ ! $keep =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( 10#$keep < 1 )); then
  usage
fi
keep=$((10#$keep))

if [[ ! -d $src ]]; then
  echo "backup.sh: not a directory: $src" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p -- "$dest"

stamp=${BACKUP_NOW:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"

# -C makes the archive entries relative to SRC_DIR.
tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

# Glob results are sorted ascending, so the newest archives are at the end.
shopt -s nullglob
candidates=("$dest"/backup-*.tar.gz)
shopt -u nullglob

backups=()
for file in "${candidates[@]}"; do
  if [[ -f $file ]]; then
    backups+=("$file")
  fi
done

count=${#backups[@]}
for ((i = 0; i < count - keep; i++)); do
  rm -f -- "${backups[i]}"
done

echo "$archive"
